callLines.line: 📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.

anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Andre Frost. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD struck Thornfield in the night. They bled while the coalition talked. (trust −5 — they notice who wasn't there.)
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Zoe Murphy and Jesse Park and Nadia Silva and Priya Sato and Ibrahim Silva will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Stonebridge answers! Theo Sato and Hana Sato and Tariq Kowalski and Ben Park and Maya Fischer and Andre Brooks will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Malik Delgado and Peter Calhoun and Rosa Nair and Sam Olsen will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
🍽️ The muster is hungry — 1,310 of 15,000 kcal fed. Bellies remember who feeds them. (loyalty strains when the food runs thin.) (trust −2 per fire per day while the muster stands hungry.)
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 2,910 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 2,440 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🌪️ THE FINALE fed in the night — 1,800 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
🕯️ Word comes back with a torn pack and no Mia. Big Ugly, out past the ridge. The fire is quieter tonight.
